description: Reporting policy for QE Framework v4. Governs quality gate evaluation, JIRA comment posting, and pipeline health knowledge updates.

qualityGateJson.purpose: Machine-readable gate result for downstream agents

recommendations.passRateBelow85: Investigate failure root causes before release
recommendations.criticalFailuresExceeded: Block release until critical issues resolved
recommendations.flakyTestsDetected: Stabilize flaky tests: review wait strategies and selectors
recommendations.avgDurationOver30s: Optimize slow tests for faster feedback
recommendations.environmentIssuesFound: Verify test environment stability before next run
recommendations.scriptErrorsFound: Fix broken test scripts: update selectors or test logic
recommendations.allPassed: Quality gate passed — ready for release consideration

knowledgeUpdate.procedure: After all JIRA operations: read knowledge file → append entry → write back. Never overwrite.
